messages:
Samir Patel: Live: DevTool blog is published (10:00 AM PT). Need a quick post-publish checklist and who owns monitoring/response.
Jena (publish-bot): Published: https://blog.redwood.inference/devtool-release. Auto-post queued to #announcements in 1m.
Priya Nair: I'll monitor press inbox and journalist replies. Dropping embargoed kit link for folks: /marketing/press/devtool_media_kit/.
Maria Lopez: Great. Diego, can you kick off paid social pause for 30m while we watch initial traction? We don't want spend going to a draft with wrong numbers.
Diego Ramos: Paused paid promos. Will only resume after Legal confirms final numbers.
Evan Chen: Note: benchmark appendix updated with final conservative numbers (median down ~25%, throughput ~1.3x). Link included in kit. Legal already reviewed.
Priya Nair: Received 2 requests for early briefings. I'll prioritize top-tier outlets and offer a 20-min slot with Evan.
Samir Patel: I'll post 2 follow-up tweets (variant with stat card + community thread). Drafts queued: short announcement + thread linking to benchmarks and one-pager.
Alex Romero: I'll stand up the coverage tracker sheet and webhook to populate #marketing-monitor with picks. Share shortlinks and UTMs please.
Coverage Bot: Monitoring started: scanning top tech feeds and Twitter for "Redwood DevTool" and the blog URL. Will post matches to #marketing-monitor.
Sales Ops: Please prepare a 1-paragraph email for CS & Sales to send to trial inquiries; include talking points and trial link. Need by +30m.
Samir Patel: Draft #announcements copy: "New: Redwood DevTool — production inference optimizations. Blog + benchmarks: https://blog.redwood.inference/devtool-release?utm_source=owned&utm_campaign=devtool_launch&utm_medium=slack". Approve?
Maria Lopez: Approve. Add one-line about trial offer for Sales & CS channels.
Evan Chen: Action for Product: if a reporter asks for deeper results, we can offer an appendix call but cite "internal benchmark results". No raw cluster logs.
Priya Nair: Received a correction request from a reporter about the latency number — they saw 30% referenced in a draft. Legal confirms we should change public copy to "up to 25%" in social cards.
Samir Patel: Updating social cards now to "up to 25%" and pushing new image with stat badge. Will replace pinned tweet.
Diego Ramos: Paid ads still paused until Samir confirms final creative.
Alex Romero: Tracker link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/PR-TRACKER-DEVTOOL (placeholder). I added columns: outlet, reporter, link, utm, status.
Coverage Bot: First pickup: MLInfra Weekly (link placeholder). Pushing to #marketing-monitor.
Maria Lopez: Nice — Priya follow up with a thank-you + offer for a demo. Samir, amplify that outlet on socials.
Priya Nair: Doing that now.
Sales Ops: Internal comm drafted and queued for 30min post-publish with talking points, one-pager, and trial link.
Evan Chen: If any reporter requests reproducibility details, route to my team; we'll do a short call but no raw infra numbers.
Samir Patel: All social posts updated with final UTMs and conservative metric language. Publishing thread and community post momentarily.
Jena (publish-bot): Reminder: I will auto-post to #announcements and #company-blog at scheduled time. If you need edits to the blog post, update the draft URL now.
Maria Lopez: Recap: Priya 	6 press follow-ups; Samir 	6 social + creative update; Diego 	6 paid pause; Alex 	6 tracker; Sales Ops 	6 internal comm; Evan 	6 press tech follow-ups. Flag blockers here.
Priya Nair: Minor ask: can we grab a fresh CEO headshot for the press kit? Sarah from design said she'd drop it in the folder.
Samir Patel: Noted. I'll also pin MLInfra Weekly pickup to the company tweet.
Coverage Bot: Monitoring summary will post in 30m with first-hour picks.
Maria Lopez: Thanks team 	7 keep updates coming in this thread so CS/Execs can follow. :rocket:
